title: Explanation-based Finetuning Makes Models More Robust to Spurious Cues
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method (explanation-based finetuning) to improve the robustness of Large Language Models against spurious correlations. While one of its evaluation datasets (SBIC) involves detecting offensive language, the study does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary objective; the focus is on the technical robustness of the model across various classification tasks.
